item.title: Paradise Found in Sumilon
item.description: Sumilon Island, located at the southeastern tip of Cebu, is a small yet stunning tropical haven. Known for its crystal-clear waters, powdery white sand beaches, and the ever-changing sandbar, this island is Cebu’s first marine protected area, established in 1974. item.description: Kabang Falls, also known as Budlaan Falls, is one of Cebu City’s most underrated natural attractions.
